notes: ⭐ THE COUNTERWEIGHT TO NAV-0030. Landscape flattens TOOLBAR depth (7 controls -> 14) but cripples SHEET height. So the orientations are complementary rather than one being better: landscape is superior for chart reading and tool ACCESS, portrait is superior for any surface that is a LIST. A mature mobile chart should arguably route list-type surfaces differently in landscape (e.g. side panel rather than bottom sheet) - TradingView does not, and it is a real defect in their landscape mode.
